rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_tcm3(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	diagcode   varchar(6) NOT NULL,
  p_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	p_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	p_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	p_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,

  v_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	v_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	v_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	v_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,diagcode),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_tcm3 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_tcm3
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,diagcode
,SUM(t.total_pt_q1) ,SUM(t.total_pt_q2) ,SUM(t.total_pt_q3) ,SUM(t.total_pt_q4) 
,SUM(t.total_q1) ,SUM(t.total_q2) ,SUM(t.total_q3) ,SUM(t.total_q4) 
FROM
t_tcm3 t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
WHERE year_rep=@b_year
GROUP BY t.hospcode,diagcode
);

other.query: select CONCAT( c.code, ', ', COALESCE(CONCAT(c.name_thai, c.name_pinin), '') ) AS name, SUM(p_q1 + p_q2 + p_q3 + p_q4) AS p, SUM(v_q1 + v_q2 + v_q3 + v_q4) AS v, SUM(p_q1) AS p_q1, SUM(p_q2) AS p_q2, SUM(p_q3) AS p_q3, SUM(p_q4) AS p_q4, SUM(v_q1) AS v_q1, SUM(v_q2) AS v_q2, SUM(v_q3) AS v_q3, SUM(v_q4) AS v_q4 from {{S_TABLE}} as s inner join cicd10tm_tcm c on diagcode = c.code inner join chospital_regis on chospital_regis.hoscode = s.hospcode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub and s.id = {{REPORT_ID}} and s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( chospital_regis.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( chospital_regis.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( chospital_regis.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( chospital_regis.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( chospital_regis.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( chospital_regis.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( chospital_regis.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( chospital_regis.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) group by c.code, c.name_thai, c.name_pinin order by v desc limit 20;

rows.query_areacode:
SELECT
	CONCAT(d.code,', ',IFNULL(CONCAT(d.name_thai,d.name_pinin),'')) name,
SUM(p_q1+p_q2+p_q3+p_q4) AS p,
SUM(v_q1+v_q2+v_q3+v_q4) AS v,
SUM(p_q1) AS p_q1,
SUM(p_q2) AS p_q2,
SUM(p_q3) AS p_q3,
SUM(p_q4) AS p_q4,
SUM(v_q1) AS v_q1,
SUM(v_q2) AS v_q2,
SUM(v_q3) AS v_q3,
SUM(v_q4) AS v_q4
	FROM
		{tablename}
		INNER JOIN cicd10tm_tcm d ON {tablename}.diagcode= d.code {sjoin}
		WHERE id='{reportid}' AND b_year = '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {cmihospcode} 
		GROUP BY
		d.code
		ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 20
